title: Searching Portuguese text
text: Let us index data twice: default tokenizer, lower-cases words, Portuguese stemmer stop-word list. stemmer reduces word root, indexing parsing query, different forms word meet middle. Compare number matches queries: story contains exact word vacinas, plain index finds nothing, stemmed index finds stories vacina vacinação. Likewise pesquisa, pesquisar pesquisadores lead stories: Stemming heuristic, dictionary. Irregular plurals always reduce root: hospital hospitais, example, kept apart Snowball algorithm. matters, search forms .
code: plain <- tnt_index_df(   pt_news,   text    = c(title, body),   filters = c(section, date) )  idx <- tnt_index_df(   pt_news,   text      = c(title, body),   filters   = c(section, date),   stemmer   = "portuguese",   stopwords = TRUE ) queries <- c("vacinas", "queimada", "pesquisa", "pesquisar")  data.frame(   query   = queries,   plain   = vapply(queries, \(q) tnt_count(plain, q), numeric(1)),   stemmed = vapply(queries, \(q) tnt_count(idx, q), numeric(1)),   row.names = NULL ) #>       query plain stemmed #> 1   vacinas     0       2 #> 2  queimada     0       2 #> 3  pesquisa     2       4 #> 4 pesquisar     1       4 tnt_search(idx, "pesquisar")[, c("score", "section", "title")] #> # A tibble: 4 × 3 #>   score section    title                                                         #>   <dbl> <chr>      <chr>                                                         #> 1  4.78 tecnologia Pesquisadores desenvolvem bateria que carrega em cinco minut… #> 2  4.78 saúde      Pesquisadores testam nova vacina contra a dengue              #> 3  2.15 tecnologia Satélite brasileiro de monitoramento é lançado com sucesso    #> 4  2.15 educação   Biblioteca municipal digitaliza acervo de jornais antigos

title: Searching Portuguese text
text: Words de, , o para appear nearly every document carry meaning retrieval. stopwords = TRUE dropped index query: also keeps natural-language queries useful, meaningful words take part ranking:
code: tnt_count(plain, "de") #> [1] 30 tnt_count(idx, "de") #> [1] 0 tnt_search(idx, "a redução dos juros", limit = 3)[, c("score", "title")] #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   score title                                                           #>   <dbl> <chr>                                                           #> 1  6.50 Banco central reduz a taxa de juros pela quarta vez             #> 2  2.58 Inflação desacelera e fecha o ano abaixo da meta                #> 3  2.58 Governo anuncia novo programa de crédito para pequenas empresas

title: Searching Portuguese text
text: default analyzer lower-cases text keeps diacritics, orçamento orcamento different words: People often type queries without accents. Set fold_accents = TRUE remove diacritics indexed words queries, spellings meet. Stored text untouched, results snippets still show accents. Folding runs stop-word removal stemming, rely correctly accented text. consequence unaccented query stemmed typed. words unaffected, Portuguese stemmer recognises suffixes, -ção, carry accent: need unaccented queries behave exactly like accented ones, strip accents text queries indexing, example iconv(x, = "ASCII//TRANSLIT"), keep original text separate stored column display.
code: tnt_count(idx, "orçamento") #> [1] 2 tnt_count(idx, "orcamento") #> [1] 0 folded <- tnt_index_df( pt_news, text = c(title, body), filters = c(section, date), stemmer = "portuguese", stopwords = TRUE, fold_accents = TRUE ) tnt_count(folded, "orcamento") #> [1] 2 tnt_search(folded, "saude agua", limit = 3)[, c("score", "title")] #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #> score title #> #> 1 3.00 Projeto recupera nascentes e devolve água a um rio seco #> 2 2.75 Campanha de vacinação contra a gripe começa na segunda-feira #> 3 2.58 Casos de dengue aumentam e municípios decretam emergência tnt_search(folded, "orcamento", highlight = title)$title_snippet #> [1] "Orçamento municipal prioriza obras de saneamento" #> [2] NA tnt_count(folded, "vacinação") #> [1] 2 tnt_count(folded, "vacinacao") #> [1] 0

title: Searching Portuguese text
text: query string supports phrases, boolean operators field prefixes.
code: # exact phrase tnt_search(idx, '"banco central"')[, c("score", "title")] #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>   score title                                               #>   <dbl> <chr>                                               #> 1  6.13 Inflação desacelera e fecha o ano abaixo da meta    #> 2  6.00 Banco central reduz a taxa de juros pela quarta vez  # either word tnt_search(idx, "enchentes OR queimadas")[, c("section", "title")] #> # A tibble: 4 × 2 #>   section       title                                                      #>   <chr>         <chr>                                                      #> 1 meio ambiente Queimadas atingem áreas de preservação no cerrado          #> 2 tecnologia    Satélite brasileiro de monitoramento é lançado com sucesso #> 3 meio ambiente Chuvas fortes causam enchentes e deslizamentos no litoral  #> 4 tecnologia    Startup recifense cria aplicativo para monitorar enchentes  # required and excluded words tnt_search(idx, "+juros -inflação")[, "title"] #> # A tibble: 2 × 1 #>   title                                                           #>   <chr>                                                           #> 1 Banco central reduz a taxa de juros pela quarta vez             #> 2 Governo anuncia novo programa de crédito para pequenas empresas  # restrict a word to one field tnt_search(idx, "title:vacina")[, "title"] #> # A tibble: 2 × 1 #>   title                                                        #>   <chr>                                                        #> 1 Pesquisadores testam nova vacina contra a dengue             #> 2 Campanha de vacinação contra a gripe começa na segunda-feira

title: Searching Portuguese text
text: Filters combine text query written ordinary R comparisons. highlight returns snippet requested field, matching words wrapped <b> tags. Note snippet marks words appear text, stemmed query.
code: tnt_search(idx, "água", filter = date >= as.Date("2025-01-01"))[, c("date", "title")] #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #> date title #> #> 1 2025-02-11 00:00:00 Orçamento municipal prioriza obras de saneamento #> 2 2025-04-22 00:00:00 Usina solar flutuante começa a operar em reservatório tnt_search(idx, "", filter = section == "esporte", order_by = date, limit = 3)[ , c("date", "title") ] #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #> date title #> #> 1 2025-04-13 00:00:00 Corrida de rua reúne vinte mil atletas no centro da cidade #> 2 2025-02-02 00:00:00 Nadador de dezessete anos vence campeonato sul-americano #> 3 2024-10-28 00:00:00 Clube centenário inaugura estádio reformado hits <- tnt_search(idx, "vacinas", highlight = c(title, body)) hits$title_snippet #> [1] "Campanha de vacinação contra a gripe começa na segunda-feira" #> [2] "Pesquisadores testam nova vacina contra a dengue" hits$body_snippet #> [1] "Idosos e crianças serão vacinados primeiro. A secretaria de saúde recebeu dois milhões de doses da vacina" #> [2] NA

title: Getting started with tantivyr
text: time data frame want search columns. tnt_index_df() infers schema, indexes every row commits one call.
code: news <- data.frame(   id     = 1:5,   title  = c(     "Orçamento público aprovado pelo congresso",     "Reforma tributária avança no senado",     "Nova lei de licitações entra em vigor",     "Congresso debate orçamentos municipais",     "Tribunal de contas analisa despesas"   ),   source = c("A", "B", "A", "C", "B"),   year   = c(2022L, 2023L, 2024L, 2024L, 2023L) )  idx <- tnt_index_df(   news,   text      = title,         # full-text column(s)   filters   = c(source, year), # columns to filter / order on   stemmer   = "portuguese",   stopwords = TRUE ) idx #>  #> ── <tnt_index> (in-memory) #> 5 documents · 4 fields #> • id: i64 #> • title: text [tnt_pt_stop] #> • source: text [raw] #> • year: i64

title: Getting started with tantivyr
text: tnt_search() returns tibble score column followed every stored field. used Portuguese stemmer, search orçamento also matches orçamentos.
code: tnt_search(idx, "orçamento") #> # A tibble: 2 × 5 #>   score    id title                                     source  year #>   <dbl> <dbl> <chr>                                     <chr>  <dbl> #> 1 0.893     4 Congresso debate orçamentos municipais    C       2024 #> 2 0.893     1 Orçamento público aprovado pelo congresso A       2022

title: Getting started with tantivyr
text: Filters can written ordinary R comparisons. combined text query. can also pass raw Tantivy query string anything helpers cover:
code: tnt_search(idx, "", filter = year >= 2024) #> # A tibble: 2 × 5 #>   score    id title                                  source  year #>   <dbl> <dbl> <chr>                                  <chr>  <dbl> #> 1     1     4 Congresso debate orçamentos municipais C       2024 #> 2     1     3 Nova lei de licitações entra em vigor  A       2024  tnt_search(idx, "congresso", filter = source == "A") #> # A tibble: 1 × 5 #>   score    id title                                     source  year #>   <dbl> <dbl> <chr>                                     <chr>  <dbl> #> 1  1.77     1 Orçamento público aprovado pelo congresso A       2022  tnt_search(idx, "", filter = year %in% c(2022, 2024), limit = 10) #> # A tibble: 3 × 5 #>   score    id title                                     source  year #>   <dbl> <dbl> <chr>                                     <chr>  <dbl> #> 1 1.39      1 Orçamento público aprovado pelo congresso A       2022 #> 2 0.875     4 Congresso debate orçamentos municipais    C       2024 #> 3 0.875     3 Nova lei de licitações entra em vigor     A       2024 tnt_search(idx, "", filter = "year:[2023 TO *] AND source:B") #> # A tibble: 2 × 5 #>   score    id title                               source  year #>   <dbl> <dbl> <chr>                               <chr>  <dbl> #> 1 0.875     2 Reforma tributária avança no senado B       2023 #> 2 0.875     5 Tribunal de contas analisa despesas B       2023

what: The explicit layer: schemas and persistence
title: Getting started with tantivyr
text: full control field stored, indexed analysed, build schema tnt_schema() tnt_*() field constructors, manage index . Add documents commit make searchable. Operations return index invisibly, pipe.
code: sch <- tnt_schema(   id    = tnt_i64(),   slug  = tnt_text(stemmer = "raw"),                 # exact key for updates   title = tnt_text(stemmer = "portuguese", stored = TRUE),   body  = tnt_text(stemmer = "portuguese"),   date  = tnt_date(fast = TRUE) )  path <- tempfile() idx <- tnt_index(path, schema = sch) docs <- data.frame(   id    = 1:2,   slug  = c("edital-001", "edital-002"),   title = c("Edital de licitação 001", "Edital de licitação 002"),   body  = c("Aquisição de equipamentos de informática.",             "Contratação de serviços de limpeza."),   date  = as.Date(c("2024-02-01", "2024-03-15")) )  idx |> tnt_add(docs) |> tnt_commit() tnt_num_docs(idx) #> [1] 2

previous_headings: The explicit layer: schemas and persistence
title: Getting started with tantivyr
text: tnt_update() replaces documents key column; tnt_delete() removes . need commit take effect.
code: idx |>   tnt_update(     data.frame(id = 1L, slug = "edital-001",                title = "Edital de licitação 001 (retificado)",                body = "Aquisição de notebooks.",                date = as.Date("2024-02-10")),     by = slug   ) |>   tnt_commit()  tnt_search(idx, "notebooks")[, c("id", "title")] #> # A tibble: 1 × 2 #>      id title                                #>   <dbl> <chr>                                #> 1     1 Edital de licitação 001 (retificado)  idx |> tnt_delete(slug == "edital-002") |> tnt_commit() tnt_num_docs(idx) #> [1] 1

previous_headings: The explicit layer: schemas and persistence
title: Getting started with tantivyr
text: -disk indexes survive across sessions. Call tnt_index() just path reopen — schema restored automatically.
code: reopened <- tnt_index(path) tnt_num_docs(reopened) #> [1] 1

title: tantivyr • Fast full-text search for R
text: fastest way tnt_index_df(): point data frame, say columns text filters, search.
code: library(tantivyr)  news <- data.frame(   id    = 1:4,   title = c(     "Orçamento público aprovado pelo congresso",     "Reforma tributária avança no senado",     "Nova lei de licitações entra em vigor",     "Congresso debate orçamentos municipais"   ),   year  = c(2022L, 2023L, 2024L, 2024L) )  idx <- tnt_index_df(   news,   text     = title,   filters  = year,   stemmer  = "portuguese",   stopwords = TRUE )  # BM25 search — note the Portuguese stemmer matches "orçamentos" too tnt_search(idx, "orçamento") #> # A tibble: 2 × 4 #>   score    id title                                      year #>   <dbl> <dbl> <chr>                                     <dbl> #> 1 0.710     1 Orçamento público aprovado pelo congresso  2022 #> 2 0.710     4 Congresso debate orçamentos municipais     2024

title: tantivyr • Fast full-text search for R
text: Filters can written plain comparisons (year >= 2024) Tantivy query strings. Snippets come back <field>_snippet columns.
code: # structured filter tnt_search(idx, "", filter = year >= 2024) #> # A tibble: 2 × 4 #> score id title year #> #> 1 1 4 Congresso debate orçamentos municipais 2024 #> 2 1 3 Nova lei de licitações entra em vigor 2024 # highlighted snippets tnt_search(idx, "congresso", highlight = title)$title_snippet #> [1] "Orçamento público aprovado pelo congresso" #> [2] "Congresso debate orçamentos municipais" # order by a fast field instead of relevance tnt_search(idx, "", order_by = year, desc = TRUE)[, c("title", "year")] #> # A tibble: 4 × 2 #> title year #> #> 1 Congresso debate orçamentos municipais 2024 #> 2 Nova lei de licitações entra em vigor 2024 #> 3 Reforma tributária avança no senado 2023 #> 4 Orçamento público aprovado pelo congresso 2022

title: tantivyr • Fast full-text search for R
text: full control, declare schema manage index . Indexes can live disk (reopened later) memory.
code: sch <- tnt_schema(   id    = tnt_i64(),   title = tnt_text(stemmer = "portuguese", stored = TRUE),   body  = tnt_text(stemmer = "portuguese") )  idx <- tnt_index(path = tempfile(), schema = sch)  idx |>   tnt_add(data.frame(id = 1L, title = "Edital de licitação", body = "...")) |>   tnt_commit()  # update (replace by key) and delete, then commit idx |>   tnt_update(data.frame(id = 1L, title = "Edital retificado", body = "..."), by = id) |>   tnt_commit()  tnt_count(idx, "edital") #> [1] 1

text: stored Logical. Keep original value returned tnt_search(). Defaults TRUE. indexed Logical. Index field can searched filtered. Defaults TRUE. fast Logical. Build columnar "fast field" enabling fast filtering ordering (required order_by tnt_search()). Defaults FALSE, except tnt_text(fast = ...) fast field default. stemmer Stemming/tokenization text field. One "none" (plain tokenization, lower-cased), "raw" (exact, untokenized — ideal ids exact filters), Snowball language "portuguese" "english". See tnt_stemmers(). stopwords Logical. Remove stop words chosen language. Bundled Portuguese English. Defaults FALSE. fold_accents Logical. Remove diacritics indexed words queries, "orcamento" finds "orçamento" (ASCII folding). Applied stop-word removal stemming, rely correctly accented text. Stored values keep accents. available stemmer = "raw". Defaults FALSE.

title: tantivyr 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-15 Initial release. tnt_index_df() indexes data frame one call (auto-schema). Explicit schema API: tnt_schema() tnt_text(), tnt_i64(), tnt_u64(), tnt_f64(), tnt_bool(), tnt_date() tnt_json(). tnt_index() creates opens -disk -memory indexes. tnt_add(), tnt_commit(), tnt_delete() tnt_update() provide incremental updates. tnt_search() returns tibble BM25 scores, structured filters (comparison expressions Tantivy query strings), snippet highlighting fast-field ordering; tnt_count() returns total match counts. Portuguese English stemming stop words, plus Snowball languages.
